sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Torqis Horizons Private Limited and its affiliates (collectively 'Torqis') value the trust you place in us and recognize the importance of secure transactions and information privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, share or otherwise process your personal data through Exaltride website www.exaltride.com. We do not offer any product or service outside India and your personal data will primarily be stored and processed in India. By visiting this Platform, you expressly agree to be bound by the terms and conditions of this Privacy Policy and agree to be governed by the laws of India.

sections.heading: Collection of Your Information
sections.content: When you use our Platform, we collect and store your information which is provided by you from time to time. We collect personal data (such as email address, delivery address, name, phone number, credit card/debit card and other payment instrument details) when you set up an account or transact with us. We also collect and analyze your personal data relating to your buying behavior, browsing patterns, preferences, and other information that you choose to provide while interacting with our Platform. This information may include the URL that you came from, which URL you go to next, your browser information, and your IP address.

sections.heading: Use of Your Information
sections.content: We use your personal data to take and fulfill orders, deliver products and services, process payments, and communicate with you about orders, products and services, and promotional offers. We use this information to assist sellers and business partners in handling orders, enhance customer experience, resolve disputes, troubleshoot problems, collect money, measure consumer interest in our products and services, inform you about offers and updates, customize your experience, detect and protect against fraud and criminal activity, and enforce our terms and conditions.

sections.heading: Data Analysis and Personalization
sections.content: We analyze your personal data to do internal research on our users' demographics, interests, usage trends, and behavior to better understand your needs and provide you with an enhanced user experience. The insights derived from this analysis may be shared with our group companies, affiliates, business partners, and third-parties who offer services to us. These parties may use such insights for promotions, advertisements, marketing, product development, and to personalize your browsing experience and customize various aspects of the user journey such as the checkout flow, payment options, and delivery recommendations.

sections.heading: Cookies and Tracking
sections.content: We use data collection devices such as 'cookies' on certain pages of the Platform to help analyze our web page flow, measure promotional effectiveness, and promote trust and safety. Cookies are small files placed on your hard drive that assist us in providing our services. Most cookies are 'session cookies' that are automatically deleted at the end of a session. You can decline/delete our cookies if your browser permits, although this may affect your ability to use certain features. We use cookies from third-party partners such as Google Analytics for marketing and analytical purposes.

sections.heading: Sharing of Personal Data
sections.content: We may disclose your personal data to third parties, such as our sellers, business partners for fulfillment of your orders, enhancing your experience, providing feedback on products, collecting payments, complying with legal obligations, conducting market research, enforcing our Terms of Use, facilitating marketing activities, analyzing data, customer service assistance, and to prevent, detect, mitigate, and investigate fraudulent or illegal activities. We may also share personal data with business partners and third-parties to enable them to offer, advertise, personalize your browsing experience and promote their own products and services to you.

sections.heading: Security Precautions
sections.content: We maintain reasonable physical, electronic and procedural safeguards to protect your information. Whenever you access your account information, we offer the use of a secure server. Once your information is in our possession, we adhere to our security guidelines to protect it against unauthorized access. However, by using the Platform, users accept the inherent security implications of data transmission over the internet which cannot always be guaranteed as completely secure. Users are responsible for ensuring the protection of login and password records for their account.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.content: We retain your personal data in accordance with applicable laws, for a period no longer than is required for the purpose for which it was collected or as required under any applicable law. However, we may retain data related to you if we believe it may be necessary to prevent fraud or future abuse, to enable Torqis to exercise its legal rights and/or defend against legal claims or if required by law. We may continue to retain your data in anonymised form for analytical and research purposes.

sections.heading: Your Rights and Choices
sections.content: You may access, correct, and update your personal data directly through the functionalities provided on the Platform. You may delete certain non-mandatory information by logging into our website and visiting Profile and Settings sections. You have an option to withdraw your consent by writing to us. You can opt-out of receiving promotional communications by logging into the Platform to unsubscribe. You have an option to opt out from tracking of personalized advertising using the 'Opt out of Ads Personalization' settings in your device's settings application.

sections.heading: Children Information
sections.content: Use of our Platform is available only to persons who can form a legally binding contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872. We do not knowingly solicit or collect personal data from children under the age of 18 years. If you have shared any personal data of children under the age of 18 years, you represent that you have the authority to do so and permit us to use the information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Introduction and Acceptance
sections.content: This document is published in accordance with the provisions of Rule 3(1) of the Information Technology (Intermediaries guidelines) Rules, 2011. The Platform is owned by Torqis Horizons Private Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 1956 with its registered office at IX-210, Tagore Gali, Gandhi Nagar, East Delhi, New Delhi - 110031, India. By accessing, browsing or using the Platform, you indicate your agreement to all the terms and conditions under these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use or access our Platform.

sections.heading: Membership Eligibility
sections.content: Transaction on the Platform is available only to persons who can form legally binding contracts under Indian Contract Act, 1872. Persons who are 'incompetent to contract' within the meaning of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 including un-discharged insolvents are not eligible to use the Platform. If you are a minor (under the age of 18 years), you may use the Platform or access content only under the supervision and prior consent/permission of a parent or legal guardian. Torqis reserves the right to terminate your membership and/or refuse to provide you with access to the Platform if it is discovered that you are under the age of 18 years.

sections.heading: Account Registration and Security
sections.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your Display Name and Password and for all activities that occur under your account. Your mobile phone number and/or e-mail address is treated as your primary identifier on the Platform. You must notify us promptly if your mobile phone number or e-mail address changes. You must not share your login details with any other person. You agree to ensure that you successfully log out from your account at the end of each session and immediately notify Torqis of any unauthorized use of your account.

sections.heading: Platform for Transaction and Communication
sections.content: The Platform enables Buyers and Sellers to transact. Torqis is not and cannot be a party to or control in any manner any transaction between the Platform's Users. All commercial/contractual terms are offered by and agreed to between Buyers and Sellers alone. Torqis does not have any control or does not determine or advise or in any way involve itself in the offering or acceptance of such commercial/contractual terms. Torqis does not make any representation or warranty as to specifics of the products or services. At no time shall Torqis hold any right, title or interest over the products nor shall Torqis have any obligations or liabilities in respect of such contract entered into between Buyers and Sellers.

sections.heading: Charges and Fees
sections.content: Torqis may charge fees for browsing and buying on the Platform including Platform fee, GT Charges (Goods Transport charges), Offer Handling Fee, Payment Handling Fee, and Cash on Delivery Fee. Torqis reserves the right to change its Fee Policy from time to time. Platform fee is levied to sustain efficient operations and continuous improvement of the platform. GT Charges are for transportation of products from seller location to your location. All fees shall be quoted in Indian Rupees and you shall be solely responsible for compliance of all applicable laws for making payments.

sections.heading: Use of the Platform - Prohibited Activities
sections.content: You shall not host, display, upload, modify, publish, transmit, update or share any information which: belongs to another person, is harmful, harassing, blasphemous, defamatory, obscene, pornographic, libelous, invasive of privacy, hateful, or racially/ethnically objectionable; is misleading; promotes illegal activities; infringes intellectual property rights; contains viruses or harmful code; threatens unity, integrity, defence, security or sovereignty of India; or violates any applicable law. You shall not use any automated device to access, copy or monitor the Platform, attempt unauthorized access, or engage in any activity that imposes unreasonable load on the Platform infrastructure.

sections.heading: Payment Terms
sections.content: All payments must be made in Indian Rupees. While availing any payment method, we will not be responsible for any loss or damage arising due to lack of authorization, exceeding preset limits, payment issues, or decline of transaction. Before shipping your order, Seller may request supporting documents to establish ownership of the payment instrument. Payment Facility is merely a facilitator providing an electronic payment collection and remittance facility. Torqis is neither acting as trustees nor in a fiduciary capacity with respect to transactions.

sections.heading: Order Fulfillment and Delivery
sections.content: Upon order confirmation, the Company will aim to facilitate delivery of your products within the communicated timeframe. Estimated delivery times may vary based on factors including delivery partner availability, order volume, traffic conditions, weather, and unforeseen circumstances. We will not be held liable for any delay in delivery. Additional delivery fees may apply based on factors such as severe weather, peak hours, high demand periods, or late-night deliveries, which will be transparently displayed before placing the order.

sections.heading: Refunds and Replacements
sections.content: Refunds will be processed once the returned product has been received by the seller. Refunds shall be made in Indian Rupees only through NEFT/RTGS or other online banking/electronic funds transfer system approved by RBI, or as gift vouchers at your choice. For Cash On Delivery transactions, refunds will be made via electronic payment transfers. Torqis reserves the right to impose limits on the number of transactions and refuse to process transactions exceeding such limits or from buyers with questionable transaction history.

sections.heading: Customer Conduct and Delivery Partners
sections.content: Torqis fosters diversity, inclusion, equity and protects delivery partners from any discrimination. Torqis prohibits discrimination against delivery partners under any circumstances. We reserve the right to withhold access to the Platform if you behave towards any delivery partner in a manner which is discourteous, disrespectful, or abusive. You are expected to treat all delivery partners with courtesy and respect.

sections.heading: Buyer Protection Program
sections.content: The Buyer Protection Program covers Buyers who are unable to successfully resolve their dispute with the Seller. Buyers can file a dispute within 3 days from the date of delivery. Only Buyers who have purchased the product on Torqis are eligible. Buyers can make a maximum of 5 claims per year with coverage limited to Rs. 50,000/-. Fraudulent charges, chargebacks initiated through credit card banks, and blacklisted buyers are not covered. Decisions made by Torqis under the Buyer Protection Program shall be final and binding.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property and Content
sections.content: All content on the Platform including text, graphics, user interfaces, photographs, trademarks, logos, sounds, music and artwork is protected by intellectual property rights. You may not copy, reproduce, republish, upload, post, publicly display, encode, translate, transmit or distribute any content without Torqis's express prior written consent. Any content you post becomes our property and you grant us worldwide, perpetual and transferable rights in such content.

sections.heading: Privacy and Data Protection
sections.content: We view protection of your privacy as a very important principle. We store and process your information including any sensitive financial information on computers protected by physical as well as reasonable technological security measures in accordance with Information Technology Act 2000 and Rules thereunder. We may share personal information with our corporate entities, affiliates, and third parties as required for providing services, complying with legal obligations, or preventing fraudulent activities. For complete details, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Disclaimer of Warranties
sections.content: This Platform and all materials, products and services are provided on 'as is' and 'as available' basis without any representation or warranties, express or implied. Torqis does not warrant that the Platform will be constantly available or that information on the Platform is complete, true, accurate or non-misleading. Torqis will not be liable in any way in relation to the contents of, or use of, or otherwise in connection with the Platform.

sections.content: IN NO EVENT SHALL TORQIS BE LIABLE FOR ANY SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES OF ANY KIND IN CONNECTION WITH THESE TERMS OF USE, EVEN IF USER HAS BEEN INFORMED IN ADVANCE OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES. Torqis does not make any representation or warranty as to the item-specifics of any Users and is not responsible for any non-performance or breach of contract between Buyers and Sellers.

sections.heading: Indemnity
sections.content: You shall indemnify and hold harmless Torqis, its owner, licensee, affiliates, subsidiaries, group companies and their respective officers, directors, agents, and employees, from any claim or demand, or actions including reasonable attorneys' fees, made by any third party or penalty imposed due to or arising out of your breach of these Terms of Use, Privacy Policy and other Policies, or your violation of any law, rules or regulations or the rights of a third party.

sections.heading: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
sections.content: These Terms of Use shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of India. The place of jurisdiction shall be exclusively in Bangalore. The Platform is presented solely for the purpose of sale in India. Torqis makes no representation that materials on the Platform are appropriate or available for use in other locations/countries other than India.

sections.heading: Shipping Methods
sections.content: The orders for the user are shipped through registered domestic courier companies and/or speed post only. We use reliable shipping partners to ensure your orders reach you safely and in good condition.

sections.heading: Delivery Timeline
sections.content: Orders are delivered within 10 days from the date of the order and/or payment or as per the delivery date agreed at the time of order confirmation and delivering of the shipment, subject to courier company / post office norms. The delivery timeline may vary based on your location and product availability.

sections.heading: Delivery Address
sections.content: Delivery of all orders will be made to the address provided by the buyer at the time of purchase. Please ensure that your shipping address is accurate and complete. We are not responsible for orders shipped to incorrect addresses provided by the customer. Address changes may not be possible once an order has been processed.

sections.heading: Delivery Confirmation
sections.content: Delivery of our services will be confirmed on your email ID as specified at the time of registration. You will receive updates about your order status and tracking information via email.

sections.heading: Shipping Costs
sections.content: If there are any shipping cost(s) levied by the seller or the Platform Owner (as the case be), the same is not refundable. Shipping charges, if applicable, will be displayed at checkout before you complete your purchase.

sections.heading: Liability for Delays
sections.content: Platform Owner shall not be liable for any delay in delivery by the courier company / postal authority. While we strive to ensure timely delivery, delays may occur due to factors beyond our control such as weather conditions, courier company operations, or other unforeseen circumstances.

sections.heading: Service Area
sections.content: Currently, we only ship within India. We are working on expanding our shipping capabilities to international destinations. Please check back for updates on international shipping availability.

sections.heading: Cancellation Policy
sections.content: The customer can choose to cancel an order any time before it's dispatched. The order cannot be canceled once it's out for delivery. However, the customer may choose to reject it at the doorstep. The time window for cancellation varies based on different categories and the order cannot be canceled once the specified time has passed. In some cases, the customer may not be allowed to cancel the order for free, post the specified time and a cancellation fee will be charged. The details about the time window mentioned on the product page or order confirmation page will be considered final. In case of any cancellation from the seller due to unforeseen circumstances, a full refund will be initiated for prepaid orders. Torqis reserves the right to accept the cancellation of any order. Torqis also reserves the right to waive off or modify the time window or cancellation fee from time to time.

sections.heading: Returns Policy
sections.content: Returns is a scheme provided by respective sellers directly under this policy in terms of which the option of exchange, replacement and/or refund is offered by the respective sellers to you. All products listed under a particular category may not have the same returns policy. For all products, the returns/replacement policy provided on the product page shall prevail over the general returns policy. Do refer the respective item's applicable return/replacement policy on the product page for any exceptions to this returns policy and the table below. The return policy is divided into three parts; Do read all sections carefully to understand the conditions and cases under which returns will be accepted.

sections.heading: Part 1 – Category, Return Window and Actions Possible
sections.content: Auto related Products - Car accessories (accessories, infotainment and decor): 2 days Replacement only. Free replacement will be provided within 7 days if the product is delivered in defective/damaged condition or different from the ordered item subject to approval from torqis. Please keep the product intact, with original accessories, user manual and warranty cards in the original packaging at the time of returning the product. No Returns categories: Some products in the above categories are not returnable due to their nature or other reasons. For all products, the policy on the product page shall prevail.

sections.heading: Part 2 - Returns Pick-Up and Processing
sections.content: During pick-up, your product will be checked for the following conditions: Correct Product - Name/image/brand/serial number/article number/bar code should match and MRP tag should be undetached and clearly visible. Complete Product - All in-the-box accessories (like remote control, starter kits, instruction manuals, chargers, headphones, etc.), freebies and combos (if any) should be present. Unused Product - The product should be unused, unwashed, unsoiled, without any stains and with non-tampered quality check seals/return tags/warranty seals (wherever applicable). Undamaged Product - The product (Charging port/port, back-panel etc.) should be undamaged and without any scratches, dents, tears or holes. Undamaged Packaging - The product's original packaging/box should be undamaged. The field executive will refuse to accept the return if any of the above conditions are not met. For any products for which a refund is to be given, the refund will be processed once the returned product has been received by the seller.

sections.heading: Part 3 - General Rules for a Successful Return
sections.content: In certain cases where the seller is unable to process a replacement for any reason whatsoever, a refund will be given. In cases where a product accessory is found missing/damaged/defective, the seller may either process a replacement of the particular accessory or issue an eGV for an amount equivalent to the price of the accessory, at the seller's discretion. During open box deliveries, while accepting your order, if you received a different or a damaged product, you will be given a refund (on the spot refunds for cash-on-delivery orders). Once you have accepted an open box delivery, no return request will be processed, except for manufacturing defects. In such cases, these category-specific replacement/return general conditions will be applicable. For products where installation is provided by Torqis's service partners, do not open the product packaging by yourself. Torqis authorised personnel shall help in unboxing and installation of the product.

sections.heading: Part 4 - Details
sections.content: Return time frame for the eligible products will be 2 days after delivery. The refund will be credited into the original source within 4-7 working days after receiving the product and if no fraudulent activity is found from user. The Exchange/replacement product will be delivered within 20 working days after successful verification of the returned product by seller. Torqis holds the right to restrict the number of returns created per order unit, post the evaluation of the product/order defect is undertaken by Torqis's authorized representative.
